The '''''Emissary''-class shuttle''' was a diplomatic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] type used after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]]. ''Emissary''-class shuttles were [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were referred to as serviceable, but far from luxurious, like the [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class shuttle]]. The [[New Dawn (Emissary-class shuttle)|''New Dawn'']], a shuttle owned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], was an ''Emissary''-class shuttle.
